pulls.title: Adds optional act_receipts support to the actor-profile draft
pulls.author: mcguinness
pulls.body:
Adds optional act_receipts support to the actor-profile draft.

`act_receipts` are signed per-hop receipt JWTs that travel alongside the readable act chain. They let an issuer record cryptographic provenance for each actor hop, so a verifier can validate who added each hop and how the chain was extended across trust boundaries.

This PR includes:

  - a new Actor Chain Receipts section defining receipt structure, chaining, issuer behavior, and recipient validation
  - a simplified secure core for receipts:
      - required claims: `iss`, `sub`, `act_sub`, `act_iss`, `prev`, `iat`
      - asymmetric signatures only
      - no receipt-level `exp` or extra ordering rules
  - explicit all-or-nothing validation for the visible `act` chain
  - subject-continuity handling for cross-issuer hops
  - key-discovery and trust rules:
      - discoverable keys preferred
      - local-policy fallback allowed for pretrusted issuers
  - new metadata:
      - `actor_receipts_supported`
      - `actor_receipts_required`
  - client capability-negotiation updates for receipt-aware paths
  - security text positioning `act_receipts` as the optional stronger provenance mechanism
  - appendix examples showing `act_receipts` being created and extended across the end-to-end flow
